task: Close three unsafe-shrink guard bypasses in ensureQuota's apply/verify comparison path

events.summary: Scoped to the unsafe-shrink guard in internal/agent and its usage source in internal/status; no API, CRD, or RBAC surface touched. Report memoization, prime-failure retry, and apparent-size accounting were deliberately left out and filed as #92, #93, #94 instead of widening this change

Three bypasses identified by reading the apply path: (a) currentEnforced == 0 skipped the guard for a directory holding data that never had a quota, because primeAppliedQuotasFromDiskOnce recorded only u.Quota > 0; (b) the guard passed when usage was unknown, and GetDirUsages swallowed report failures into an apparent-size walk so unknown almost never surfaced; (c) appliedQuotas and the enforced-limit annotation stored raw sizeBytes while the guard compared KB-floored ExpectedEnforcedBytes

Recorded u.Used for every path in the existing startup snapshot as a zero-cost brownfield pre-filter, added status.GetReportedUsage which propagates report errors with no walk fallback, made the guard reject on unknown usage, and computed enforcedBytes once for every comparison and both stores

An independent review pass found the first version of the fix gated the brownfield check on !isShrink, which also caught a legitimate grow on a path already over its quota; reproduced by running the existing grow test with the startup snapshot primed the way Run() primes it, which rejected the grow as an unsafe shrink

Gated the brownfield check on currentEnforced == 0, the actual brownfield condition, and strengthened TestEnsureQuota_AllowsGrowThatDoesNotFullyClearOverQuota to prime the snapshot so it guards the invariant it documents instead of passing vacuously

Each new and strengthened test was confirmed non-vacuous by deliberately reintroducing the defect it targets and observing it fail: reverting the guard to !isShrink fails the grow test, disabling the guard fails the boundary-crossing test, reverting the cache short-circuit to a raw comparison fails the same-bucket no-op test, and storing raw sizeBytes in appliedQuotas fails the unit-consistency test
events.scope: unsafe-shrink guard branch reachability and unit consistency, exercised through the stubbed CommandRunner seam only

events.summary: go test ./... passed for all 14 packages with no FAIL, go vet ./... and gofmt -l . were clean, and the working tree was confirmed free of the temporary probe and breakage patches used during verification

events.summary: The three documented bypasses are closed and the review-caught regression is fixed, within the scope stated in e1 and at the evidence level stated in e7
